title: Cross-cutting: retry-then-DLQ handoff when maxAttempts is exhausted
asA: operator observing a terminally failing job
iWant: the applied queue's DLQ to receive the message after maxAttempts is exhausted, and jobFailed to fire on the sink with a terminal error code
soThat: a terminally failing job lands on the queue's DLQ (as ratified by the messaging-queue-cloudflare DLQ contract) and the run log records the terminal event

acceptanceCriteria.description: The retry-and-fail probe's report, after the three failing jobStarted events and the terminal jobFailed event, records that the underlying in-memory queue driver invoked the DLQ producer path (dlqOverflow flag on the driver's introspection API) for the failing message id. The DLQ handoff is a queue-blueprint concern; jobs-background only asserts the terminal jobFailed event fires and the DLQ path is exercised, not the DLQ delivery contents (the queue blueprint covers that).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture with SIMULATE_HANDLER_THROW=true and the in-memory queue seam active
acceptanceCriteria.when: the retry-and-fail probe runs to completion
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe report carries dlqInvoked true; the sink shows jobFailed with terminalErrorCode; the retry-and-fail run report at .rcf/reports/blueprints/jobs-background/retry-and-fail.json carries aggregateVerdict pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: Retry chain observability. Given a handler that throws retryable on every delivery up to maxAttempts, when the chain completes, then the run-log carries a jobStarted plus jobFailed pair per delivery attempt and one final jobDeadLettered event; the run-log ordering is stable and each event carries the same jobId; a mutation SIMULATE_JOB_LOG_DUPLICATE=true fires an extra jobStarted and the observer FAILS.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a handler throwing retryable up to maxAttempts
acceptanceCriteria.then: the run-log has jobStarted/jobFailed pairs per attempt and one jobDeadLettered; ordering stable; jobId consistent; the duplicate mutation FAILS
